verdict.rationale: Unity serves llms.txt files in several places: a marketing-site llms.txt at unity.com, a site-wide '# Unity Documentation' llms.txt on docs.unity.com, and a dedicated llms.txt for the CLI docs, so an agent has machine-readable entry points. However, the core engine manual on docs.unity3d.com returns 404 for llms.txt and has no .md page mirrors, so the main documentation is not agent-oriented. Missing for 10: llms.txt on docs.unity3d.com, markdown mirrors of manual pages, independent or hands-on confirmation that the docs.unity.com index covers the engine manual.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: docs.unity.com also serves a site-wide llms.txt index ('# Unity Documentation')
Its docs section serves its own llms.txt ('# Unity command-line interface (CLI)')
